text: The fact is that we don't want to be free. What is responsible for our problems is the fear of losing what we have and what we know.
Fear is the very thing that you do not want to be free from.
What you call 'yourself' is fear. The 'you' is born out of fear; it lives in fear, functions in fear and dies in fear.
The body cannot be afraid of death. The movement that is created by society or culture is what does not want to come to an end.
What you are afraid of is not death.
note: Same passage as the 'body cannot be afraid of death' line.

text: God or Enlightenment is the ultimate pleasure, uninterrupted happiness. No such thing exists.
note: Also attributed to Mind is a Myth (Goodreads) and found in the Wikisource text of Thought is Your Enemy.

text: It is fear that makes you believe that you are ...
note: Partial; summary truncated the quote.

text: You love fear. The ending of fear is death, and you don't want that to happen. I am not talking of wiping out the...
note: Book not stated by azquotes/quotefancy; themed with the No Way Out fear passages. Partial.

text: the death of fear is the only death
note: Summary wording of the continuation of the 'You love fear' passage.

text: Death described as atoms changing form, with nothing born and nothing dead.
note: Paraphrase from Goodreads author page; book attribution not confirmed.

text: A passage that ends with the speaker saying there is no escape.
chapter: Ch. 7 What Kind Of Human Being Do You Want?
note: Quotepark labels the passage with this chapter; text not surfaced.

text: You can have the courage to climb the mountain, swim the lakes, go on a raft to the other side of the Atlantic or Pacific. That is not courage. ...
note: Partial. Summary continuation: the courage to stand on your own two feet cannot be given by somebody; another summary gives 'stand on your two solid feet' as in-quote wording.

text: Courage is not an instrument or quality you can use to get somewhere. The stopping of doing is courage.
note: The second sentence also appears on Mind Is a Myth collections.

text: Nature is busy creating absolutely unique individuals, whereas culture has invented a single mold to which all must conform.
note: Goodreads files it under The Courage to Stand Alone; other sites attribute it to Mind is a Myth ch. IV, where it ends 'It is grotesque.'

text: Each time a thought is born, you are born; thought is short-lived. Traditional rebirth read as this cycle.
note: Paraphrase; fragments 'each time a thought is born, you are born' and 'thought is shortlived' as given by the summary.

text: it has to dawn on you that it is not leading you anywhere
note: Wikiquote dates the Chrystal edition 2001.

text: There seems to be no way out.
note: Closing line of a passage quoted on praveennv.blogspot, whose tagline is this line.

text: You cannot look at your thought, because you cannot separate yourself from thought.
note: Paraphrase of a CTSA excerpt on praveennv.blogspot.

text: Questioning the solutions requires a tremendous courage.
note: Blog post title quoting CTSA; also filed under No Way Out elsewhere.

text: My teaching, if that is the word you want to use, has no copyright. You are free to reproduce, distribute, interpret, misinterpret, distort, garble, do what you like...
note: Copyright release printed in this and several other publications of his conversations. Full sentence ends '...even claim authorship, without my consent or the permission of anybody.'

text: I have had to search and it is the search itself which has been choking me and keeping me out of my natural state.
There is no such thing as spiritual or psychological enlightenment because there is no such thing as spirit or psyche.
note: Some reprints add 'at all'.

text: Thinking about and struggling against 'sorrow' is sorrow. Since you can't stop thinking, and thinking is sorrow, you will always suffer.
The basic method of maintaining the continuity is the repetition of the question, 'How?'
You hook up each thought with the next, creating a false continuity. It is that continuity that is the problem.
It is not an illusion, only your experience of it is an illusion.
Your traditions are choking you.
you arrive seeking understanding, while I am only interested in making it crystal clear that there is nothing to understand.
chapter: Ch. IV There Is Nothing To Understand

text: The only way to find your own path is to reject the others.
note: Paraphrase; Goodreads verbatim form is 'Only if you reject all the other paths can you discover your own path.'

text: it is the mind that has created God out of fear
note: praveennv cites Mind Is a Myth p.31; azquotes renders a version as 'man has created God out of fear', which Wikiquote places in The Mystique of Enlightenment.

text: The stopping of doing is courage.
note: Attributed both to The Courage to Stand Alone (Goodreads) and to Mind is a Myth collections.

text: A guru is one who tells you to throw away all the crutches that we have been made to believe are essential for our survival.
note: Wikiquote cites the Maverick compilation p.141.

text: The highest goal is like a horizon that recedes as you approach it, a projection of your own fear.
note: Paraphrase; 'a projection of your own fear' given as in-quote wording.

text: the same old nonsense repeating itself
note: Fragment, on memory.

text: there is no individual there at all
The term natural state is not a synonym for enlightenment, freedom or God-realization.
note: Paraphrase from a Medium book summary.

text: All I can guarantee you is that as long as you are searching for happiness, you will remain unhappy.
note: No book given by the aggregator.

text: All your experiences, all your meditations, all your prayer, all...
note: Partial.

text: There is no such thing as truth. The only thing...
note: Continuation per summary: the only thing that is actually there is your 'logically' ascertained premise, which you call truth. Other sites place it in Mind is a Myth ch. 1.

text: We are not created for any grander purpose than the...
note: Partial.

text: whatever you do to be free from the self also is a self-centred activity
all gurus are welfare organizations providing petty experiences to their followers
as long as you depend upon somebody for solving your problems, so long you remain helpless
Thought is too slow to capture life.
note: Paraphrase; verbatim form in Mind is a Myth is 'Thought can never capture the movement of life, it is much too slow.'

text: We never look at anything.
note: Paraphrase of the blog post 'You never see anything'.

text: WHAT I HAVE FOUND, OFF AND BY MYSELF, IS THAT ALL TEACHERS RELIGIOUS, SECULAR AND THOSE SCIENTISTS AND FILTHY DOCTORS ARE WRONG
note: WELL page title, all caps as published; truncated in the listing. ugkrishnamurti.in gives the opening as 'What I have found of and by myself,'.

text: His findings run counter to everything anyone has said in any field of human thought.
note: Paraphrase of the continuation of the opening, from Google Groups / sciforums copies.

text: The human being is more despicable than all other life forms on the planet.
note: Paraphrase from the Google Groups copy.

text: There is no need to change this world or yourself.
note: Paraphrase from the ugkrishnamurti.in copy.

text: Although I assert that all doctors should be shot, I don't advise others not to see a doctor.
note: ugkrishnamurti.in summary renders it 'all doctors should be shot, I don't advise others not to see a doctor'.

text: I don't know what I will do if I am in a situation where I want to prolong my life a little longer.
Freeing the body from what is put in it by spiritual teachers or secular teachers, or by those scientists and medical technology.
note: Wording differs across copies.

text: Sex is for reproduction; people have turned it into a pleasure movement; an enlightened man can never have sex because he cannot reproduce another one like him.
note: Paraphrase from the ugkrishnamurti.in copy.

text: The native intelligence of the human body is amazing, and it is all it needs to survive in any dangerous situation in life.
note: Paraphrase from the ugkrishnamurti.in copy.

text: a clinical death will occur, and it is not the near-death experience of those 'near death' scoundrels
note: One copy; summary says another copy reproduces the same remark in full.

text: His experience has nothing to do with the spiritual nonsense they preach.
you keep buying these bogus wares offered up by the experts
note: One transcription (WELL or Medium).

text: frauds who promise you some goodies that they can never deliver
note: Of religious and political figures.

text: You think when you don't want to do anything. Thinking is a poor alternative to acting. Act, don't think!
note: Wikiquote quotes a passage where UG urges acting over thinking; Bhatt precedes it with his own observation 'You are what you do, not what you say you want to do', which has sometimes been misquoted as part of UG's statement.

text: Tell them that there is nothing to understand.
note: Wikipedia attributes it to UG as expressing that his assertions were experiential and not speculative.
